note: ALTCHA Obfuscate (submodule of altcha) provides three field formatters chosen on Manage display (entity_view_display): altcha_obfuscated_email (email fields, mailto:), altcha_obfuscated_telephone (telephone, tel:), altcha_obfuscated_string (string). The value is AES-256-GCM encrypted (ObfuscationUtility, ext-openssl) and rendered inside an ALTCHA obfuscation-plugin widget with a 'Click to reveal' proof-of-work button. Per-formatter setting: reveal_text_override (schema field.formatter.settings.altcha_obfuscated_*). Global keys in altcha.settings: obfuscate_reveal_text, obfuscate_max_number, obfuscate_library_override. No configure route/permission/drush. Medium/hard cases create namespaced fields (field_aobf_*) on node.article and read/set the view-display formatter type + settings, or read the global obfuscate_reveal_text; all restore baseline.

evals.prompt: Which field formatters does the altcha_obfuscate module provide, and which field types does each one work on?
evals.expected_output: altcha_obfuscated_email (email fields, mailto:), altcha_obfuscated_telephone (telephone fields, tel:), and altcha_obfuscated_string (string fields). You pick one on the field's Manage display.

evals.prompt: How does altcha_obfuscate hide a field's value from bots, and what does a real visitor do to see it?
evals.expected_output: The value is AES-256-GCM encrypted server-side (ObfuscationUtility::encrypt) and rendered inside an ALTCHA obfuscation-plugin widget, so the plaintext isn't in the HTML. A visitor clicks 'Click to reveal' and the browser solves a proof-of-work to decrypt and show it.

evals.prompt: In altcha_obfuscate, what per-formatter setting can you change, and which global ALTCHA settings influence the obfuscation (reveal text and complexity)?
evals.expected_output: Per-formatter: reveal_text_override (overrides the reveal button text for that field). Global (altcha.settings): obfuscate_reveal_text (default reveal text), obfuscate_max_number (obfuscation complexity), obfuscate_library_override.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an email field field_aobf_email whose display is protected by altcha_obfuscate. Inspect the live default view display and state which field formatter is applied to field_aobf_email.
evals.expected_output: field_aobf_email uses the altcha_obfuscated_email formatter: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component type is altcha_obfuscated_email.

evals.prompt: The global reveal-button text for ALTCHA obfuscation has been customized on this site. Inspect the live altcha.settings configuration and report the configured obfuscate_reveal_text value.

The Article content type has a string field field_aobf_task that currently displays as plain text. Using altcha_obfuscate, change its default display so the value is obfuscated (hidden behind ALTCHA until revealed), and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_aobf_task component's formatter type to altcha_obfuscated_string in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default (via Manage display, or $vd->setComponent('field_aobf_task', ['type' => 'altcha_obfuscated_string', ...])->save()).

evals.prompt: On the Article content type, hide the email field field_aobf_mail from bots using altcha_obfuscate, and make its reveal button say 'Show address'. Apply the change to the live default display.
evals.expected_output: Set field_aobf_mail's formatter to altcha_obfuscated_email with settings.reveal_text_override = 'Show address' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.
